correctness.rationale: The replication number is r=(v-1)/(k-1)>1; the point-by-block incidence matrix has Gram matrix (r-1)I+J and full row rank. Thus b>=v, and double-counting pairs gives v>=k(k-1)+1. Up to two selected points, equality moves can be matched and distinct triples can be completed on or off a pair-line. For a collinear distinct triple all three pair-lines coincide; a fresh point has either all three relations (available iff k>=4) or none (v>k). For a noncollinear triple the three pair-lines meet only at chosen points, have k-2 fresh points each, and leave v-3k+3>=(k-2)^2 other points. These realize the three single incidences and no incidence, and no pair of incidences is possible. With repeats, only the relations using the distinct pair can be nontrivial, and both on/off choices are available if that pair exists; reusing an old point is forced by equality. This exhausts the extension inventory in both directions, giving the four-round EF strategy on each side and the common three-round theory. A rank-four existential sentence asking for four distinct points on the same pair-line separates the two classes. Fano and projective order three realize the two sides. The inspected frozen output exhibits five samples only and is not the arbitrary-design proof.

evidence: The 2026/11/8 plane record gives FO^4 equivalence iff min(line size,4) agrees. The 2026/11/8 projective collapse record gives stronger four-variable equivalence by q=2 versus q>=3 for dimensions at least two, extending to arbitrary abstract projective planes. Paolini–Quadrellaro's 'rank 2' refers to incidence-geometry rank, with free nondegenerate infinite structures prominent in the stated theorems.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Quantifier-free removal of repeated-point collinearity preserves rank, and a rank-four sentence can reuse only four variable names. Therefore these stronger geometry statements imply the same-side equivalence on their subfamilies, not on arbitrary uniform Steiner 2-designs. They are also later-dated catalogue comparisons, not evidence of prior order.

value.rationale: This gives a natural exact expressibility boundary: no design can be distinguished in three rounds in the point-only signature, and the first separating level records just whether a pair-line admits a fourth distinct point. The classification holds across all finite designs satisfying the axioms, not just highly symmetric examples, and gives both a separating sentence and a uniform obstruction to any stronger distinction at that rank.
